notes:
Lead source: inbound contact via docs & pricing page. Product interest: Hosted API (self-serve).

Quick summary: small digital mental-health coaching app. Looking to add conversational triage + doc search over coaching content and session notes (non-PHI initially). Curious about embeddings for search and cheap summarization for weekly check-ins.

HIPAA-adjacent concerns: customer repeatedly asked about retention controls and whether tokens/requests are stored/used for training. Wants explicit retention TTLs and ability to opt-out of training. Legal asked: 'We need assurance that transcripts won't be used to train external models and need audit trails.'

Technical requirements / preferences:
- Workload: chat-first (support/triage) + embeddings for content search; low concurrent users (~50 daily active), bursty during morning coaching windows.
- Latency target: user-facing chat 150-250ms per token (ideally <300ms end-to-end).
- Throughput: very low (peak 3-5 rps), cost-sensitive.
- Models: prefer smaller open or quantized models to control cost; open to Redwood model recommendations and quantization guidance.
- Routing/fallback: simple fallback to a cheaper model variant during spikes.

Engagement timeline + discovery notes:
- 2026-02-18: inbound contact via pricing page form; filled 'security' checkbox. (lead captured)
- 2026-02-22: intro call w/ Maya P. — demo of app and high-level ask. Fireflies: ff_20260225_verdant-meeting-8421. Action: send security FAQ.
- 2026-02-28: internal technical screen w/ Eric L. — walked through sample prompt flows; discussed embeddings footprint. POC ask: 2-week trial to validate summarization quality + embedding recall.
- 2026-03-04: legal email received requesting retention TTLs and contract language for non-use/opt-out of training (thread-kl2m4c5j9).

POC / success criteria:
- Summarization quality >= internal baseline on 50 sample session notes (labels provided by Verdant).
- Embedding recall > 0.85 on a 100-query test set (customer will provide dataset).
- Confirmed retention settings (7/30/90 day TTL options) and a written statement on model training opt-out.

Stated blockers: legal needs assurance on PHI handling; finance needs ARR estimate; wants minimal implementation work — prefers SDK + quickstart.

Customer quotes (paraphrased):
- 'We try to avoid PHI in transcripts but need contractual assurances.'
- 'If Redwood can give a documented retention policy and an easy way to turn off training, we can start small.'

Requested artifacts from Redwood: security FAQ, sample DPA clause language for non-training, recommended model list for cost/latency tradeoffs, sample cost estimate for 1k monthly active users (projected).

Next actions (short):
- Maya: send tailored security FAQ + DPA template (ASAP).
- Eric: prepare 2-week POC checklist + sample token budget and SDK quickstart.
- Schedule 30m technical follow-up the week of 2026-03-09.
